fields.why: 2015 to 2016 rate changes are ranked across race/ethnicity ('largest relative rate change ... among blacks'), age groups and county urbanization levels.
Tables 1-3 report the changes for 5 race/Hispanic-origin groups, 7 age groups and the 6 NCHS urban-rural county levels, and the text ranks each; sex has 2 levels and states are geography.

The z-tests and gamma-CI overlap rule test 2015 vs 2016 within each group, not differences in change across groups, so the 'largest' claims are untested rankings; the CI-overlap flag is a false hit (the overlap rule backs a period contrast, not a cross-group claim).
